citation: [2120 S. Prairie Ave. (Clapp / Gorton house).] Photograph of the house from Prairie Avenue south-east of it; unknown photographer, undated (c. 1880s-1900s). Reproduced on chicagology.com, Prairie Avenue, 2120 S. Prairie.
author: unknown photographer
repository: chicagology.com (secondary reproduction; the original holder is not named). Prairie library image a20-chicagology-2120-gorton-photo (stream-2000-2100.json).
locator: A cast-iron gas lamp on the parkway beside the walk, just south of the house's entrance stoop.
rights_note: A secondary web reproduction whose original source and rights are not stated (the Prairie library's ruling: 'unknown - link only'). Only what stands in the street and where is read from it; nothing is derived from the image as an asset.
